messages:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-12 resolved and closed. Root cause: intermittent LB connection resets + aggressive server-side timeouts.

sarah: Quick postmortem follow-up thread for streaming/chat reliability. Need owners, concrete timelines, and a recurrence plan. Main buckets: reconnect/backoff logic, timeout tuning, observability, SDK guidance, and recurrence analysis.

jake: I'll own reconnect/backoff + routing fallback (A1). Deliverable: working prototype + integration tests.

priya: I'll take A2 (timeout classification + metrics). Will add chunk gap histograms and label partial responses.

marta: A3: dashboard + alerts. Suggest SLO: partial_response_rate < 0.3% over 10m, alert if >0.6% for 3 consecutive 5m windows.

alex: Eng-devex can handle A5 (SDK retry guidance + examples). We should sync on API ergonomics before changing retry behavior.

rachel: I'll run A4 (recurrence pattern analysis). I'll correlate incidents with deploys, region traffic, and model updates.

sarah: Proposed ticket timeline: A1 (jake) prototype by 2026-04-01, A1 PR for review by 2026-04-08. A2 (priya) metrics + classification by 2026-03-30. A3 (marta) dashboards/alerts by 2026-03-31. A4 (rachel) recurrence report by 2026-04-15. A5 (alex) SDK guidance draft by 2026-04-20.

jake: Backoff config sketch (will refine in PR):
```
reconnect: {
  attempts: 8,
  base_ms: 150,
  max_ms: 8000,
  jitter_pct: 0.3,
  fallback_after: 4  // switch to polling if reconnects fail
}
```

priya: Metrics we'll add: chunk_interval_ms.p50/p95, partial_response_flag (bool), disconnect_reason, reconnect_count. Tag by region/model/sdks.

marta: Dashboards: per-region partial_response trend, chunk interval heatmap, reconnect attempts histogram. I'll wire up an alert to the incidents channel + severity pager if SLO breach.

alex: For SDKs: recommend conservative client retry (exponential + capped), expose a `streamingFallback` opt-in, and publish migration guide. No forced behavior change without canary.

rachel: Early signal: spikes align with EMEA 09:00 and immediately after model config updates. Will include hypothesis testing in the report.

jake: Rollout plan: feature-flagged on Dedicated nodes -> canary cohort (5% traffic) -> ramp to 50% if partial_response delta <= 0.1% -> full. Auto-rollback if negative impact.

sarah: Add A6: synthetic failure tests (owner: infra-tests) to simulate dropped packets and measure recovery window. Target tests in CI by 2026-04-05.

priya: I'll add a lightweight `partial_response` tag to logs so we can tie it to infra events and LB metrics.

marta: Creating tickets in the incidents board now and adding estimates. Please add rough eng hours to your tickets.

jake: Estimate for A1: 24h prototyping + 40h integration & tests. A2: 16h. A3: 12h. A4: 20h. A5: 10h. A6: 18h (infra-tests).

sarah: Thanks. Action recap: A1 reconnect/backoff + fallback - jake. A2 timeout tuning + metrics - priya. A3 dashboards + alerts - marta. A4 recurrence analysis - rachel. A5 SDK guidance - alex/eng-devex. A6 synthetic tests - infra-tests.

ops-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-12

sarah: Schedule: 30m sync Friday to review PR plan and canary gating. @jake @priya @marta @alex please prepare 5-min updates. :thumbsup:
